name: auditfellow
description: Your organization's internal audit methodology, loaded before ChatGPT writes findings, risks, controls, workpapers or GenAI audit documents.
shortDescription: Internal audit deliverables that follow your house methodology.
longDescription: AuditFellow connects ChatGPT to the internal audit methodology of your organization. Paste the organization's key once; from then on every finding, observation, risk, control, workpaper, GenAI audit or data strategy document follows the method your audit function agreed on instead of a generic template. The plugin fetches only the task the request calls for and the knowledge it depends on. Nothing you ask or receive is stored by AuditFellow.
defaultPrompt: Draft an audit finding from these fieldwork notes
Turn this process walkthrough into a risk and control matrix
Write the workpaper for this test of controls
